Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

The BioProduction Group (BPG) provides the technology, materials and services to develop and produce life-changing medicines efficiently, sustainably and cost-effectively. Through our scientific expertise, differentiated innovations and global network, we help customers advance biologics, vaccines and advanced therapies from development to commercialization. With flagship products like the DynaDrive bioreactor and DynaCellect Magnetic Separation System, BPG supports some of the most innovative breakthrough medicines, helping bring treatments to patients faster and advancing Thermo Fisher Scientific’s mission to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer.

Our Thermo Fisher Scientific site in Darmstadt is a key hub for the marketing, sales, service and support of our life sciences products. Home to around 300 colleagues, including approximately 120 field-based employees, the site brings together inside sales, our EMEA Customer Contact Center and a dedicated laboratory for customer training. From Darmstadt, we support customers across scientific research with a portfolio of more than 50,000 products, including solutions from leading brands such as Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Gibco and Ion Torrent.

Discover Impactful Work
Join Thermo Fisher Scientific as an Inside Sales Representative (m/f/d) Bioprocessing and be part of our mission to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. In this role, you'll generate sales growth through virtual and digital channels while building strong relationships with customers across academic, biotech, pharma, clinical and industrial markets. You'll promote and sell our comprehensive portfolio of scientific products and services, using consultative selling skills to understand customer needs and provide optimal solutions. Working in a collaborative environment, you'll develop and execute strategic sales plans, manage customer relationships through our CRM system, and partner with cross-functional teams to achieve business targets. This position offers excellent career development opportunities within a global leader in serving science.

A Day in the Life:
Generate sales growth through virtual and digital channels while building strong relationships with customers across academic, biotech, pharma, clinical and industrial markets. Promote and sell our comprehensive portfolio of scientific products and services, using consultative selling skills to understand customer needs and provide optimal solutions.

What to expect:

- Develop and execute strategic sales plans
- Build and maintain strong customer relationships
- Manage customer relationships through our CRM system
- Use consultative selling skills to understand customer needs and provide optimal solutions
- Promote and sell our comprehensive portfolio of scientific products and services
- Partner with cross-functional teams to achieve business target
- Travel 10-25% for customer meetings and internal events

Keys to Success:

Education

- Bachelor’s degree with laboratory and/or research experience
- Preferred Fields of Study: Life Sciences, Biology, Chemistry or related scientific field

Experience

- Previous Sales Experience is an advantage but not required
- Experience with scientific products/instruments preferred but not required

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

- Strong consultative selling and relationship building skills
- Proficiency with CRM systems (preferably Salesforce) and Microsoft Office suite
- Ability to develop and maintain deep product and technical knowledge
- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
- Effective at working both independently and collaboratively
- Excellent time management and ability to handle multiple priorities
- Demonstrated problem-solving and analytical capabilities
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with fluency in both English and German

Benefits:
We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!

Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need.

#StartYourStory at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.

Apply today! http://jobs.thermofisher.com (http://jobs.thermofisher.com/)

Deine VisionWe are Bloomwell, the most exciting health tech scale up in medical cannabis. Our goal is to make access to therapy as simple as possible for patients. We bring medical cannabis into everyday life, digital, simple and patient centric. And we are growing fast.

That is why we need you, as Business Development Manager , to own the next stage of our growth and take Bloomwell beyond Germany. We are evaluating International markets and you lead the work of turning that opportunity into reality. You research possible markets, build the entry strategy, set up the right partnerships and structures, and make sure our launches actually succeed rather than just look good on paper. You work closely with management and take full ownership of your domain.
Deine Aufgaben
• Develop and drive market entry strategies for our international markets, tailored to the regulatory and competitive environment of each country
• Conduct in depth market research covering demand, competitors, pricing and regulatory requirements for medical cannabis and related health products
• Build a repeatable market entry playbook covering legal compliance, licensing, local partnerships and operational setup
• Identify, evaluate and negotiate with local partners such as distributors, pharmacies, clinics and logistics providers
• Own the business case and commercial plan for each market, including pricing, unit economics and growth levers
• Coordinate cross functional launch activities together with product, marketing, legal, regulatory and operations teams
• Navigate local regulatory and compliance requirements around medical cannabis and healthcare products in cooperation with legal and regulatory affairs
• Monitor performance after launch and adjust the strategy based on real market feedback
• Report progress, risks and recommendations directly to management
• Represent Bloomwell in negotiations and on market visits, with regular travel to our international markets

The position is initially limited to 18 months. This is in accordance with our internal governance and planning principles, under which we structure employment relationships for a defined period of time initially. If performance is as expected, there is generally the prospect of a long-term continuation of the employment relationship. A possible extension will be discussed well in advance of the end of the fixed-term period.

Dein Profil
• Proven experience leading or heavily driving international market expansion, including full ownership of a market launch from strategy to execution
• Experience in expanding businesses beyond German borders is a strong plus, with a solid understanding of the regulatory, cultural and commercial dynamics of these markets
• Solid understanding of the regulatory and licensing frameworks for medical cannabis in at least one international market, for example bodies such as the MHRA, EOF, FDA, DEA, Health Canada or the TGA, and the ability to quickly get up to speed on new ones
• Background in business development, strategy consulting, venture building or international growth roles
• Willingness to travel regularly
• Strong analytical skills, comfortable building business cases, market sizing models and unit economics
• Confident communicator who negotiates well and holds their own with stakeholders and international partners
• Entrepreneurial mindset, motivated by ambiguity and by building something from zero
• Structured and hands on working style, able to translate strategy into concrete execution
• Fluent English is essential for this role
• Genuine interest in the cannabis industry and health tech is a must, a background in healthcare, pharma or another regulated market is a nice plus

Warum wir?You get to actively shape things from day one, in a growing market, with flat hierarchies and real room to decide. No slow moving structures, just fast paths and an open culture where your ideas count.
This is what you can expect:
• Ownership from day one with a direct line to management
• Flexible working hours and hybrid work
• eGym Wellpass for health and fitness
• Job-Bike
• Fresh fruit, snacks and drinks in our Frankfurt office near the Messe
• Regular team events and a vibrant company culture

*We use the gender neutral abbreviation (m/w/d) to indicate that this position is open to all genders.

Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2020 gestalten wir ein innovatives, digitales Cannabis-Ökosystem – mit dem klaren Ziel, die Versorgung von Patient:innen zu verbessern und die moderne Cannabistherapie voranzutreiben. Wir bilden die gesamte Wertschöpfungskette ab (mit Ausnahme des Anbaus) und setzen Maßstäbe in Telemedizin, eRezept-Lösungen, digitalen Zahlungswegen und datengestützter Forschung. Teamlead Reliability Engineers

Imagine a future where you lead an international engineering team that improves the safety, reliability, and performance of our wind farms.Join us in this role where you’ll provide people and technical leadership to the Continental Europe Reliability Engineering team. You’ll set priorities, develop capabilities, and enable consistent, high-quality reliability support across our wind farms. Through data-driven decisions and close collaboration, you’ll help address technical risks, improve asset performance, and strengthen the way we work across sites and turbine platforms. Welcome to Generation CE You’ll be part of WTG Engineering where you, together with your colleagues, will support our operational sites by identifying and addressing technical risks, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities. You’ll connect Reliability Engineers, site teams, CE Engineering, Technical Support, and other specialist functions to coordinate effective corrective and preventive actions. As a team, we share knowledge, support one another, and turn technical insight into practical improvements. We succeed as one by building trust across sites, giving our experts the context and space to make decisions, and keeping safety at the heart of our work. You’ll play an important role in: leading, motivating, and developing an international team of Reliability Engineers through clear objectives, coaching, competence planning, and development conversations translating Generation, CE Engineering, and site priorities into an aligned reliability engineering plan with clear ownership, milestones, and outcomes ensuring structured analysis of reliability performance, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, technical risks, and emerging trends overseeing root-cause analyses, technical assessments, corrective and preventive actions, and prioritised reliability improvement initiatives strengthening consistent reliability practices, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across operational sites, engineering functions, suppliers, and technical support teams promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance with asset integrity, HSE, governance, and applicable technical requirements. To succeed in the role, you: have a relevant technical or engineering qualification within mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, reliability, asset management, wind energy, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience bring leadership experience that enables you to develop people, set priorities, allocate resources, and create clarity across an international or multi-site team understand wind turbine operations, reliability engineering, technical support, maintenance engineering, asset integrity, or another high-reliability industry have strong knowledge of reliability and continuous-improvement methods, such as root-cause analysis, trend analysis, failure-mode analysis, reliability-centred maintenance, risk assessment, and corrective-action management can interpret technical and operational performance data and turn your findings into clear priorities, decisions, and measurable improvement actions communicate complex technical matters clearly, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and work professionally in English. Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. Shape the future with us Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate. As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com (accommodation@orsted.com) . Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position. Position salary range: For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.Pre-employment background checks:For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

Job Description

About the Job

The Industrial Supply Chain Manager (I-SCM) is responsible for managing and optimizing the manufacturing and supply chain network to ensure cost-effective, reliable, and scalable production. The role leads industrialization initiatives such as volume ramp-ups, manufacturing transfers, product changes, and supplier and factory onboardings while serving as the Supply Chain Management representative in industrialization projects.

Working closely with cross-functional teams, the I-SCM ensures that supply chain requirements are fully integrated into project execution, drives capacity and loading strategies across internal and external manufacturing sites, and supports continuous improvement initiatives to enhance supply chain performance, efficiency, and resilience.

Your Responsibilities

- Lead Volume Ramp-Up (VRU) activities, manufacturing transfers, supplier and factory onboardings, and product optimization initiatives.
- Represent Supply Chain Management (SCM) in industrialization and Product Change Notification (PCN) projects, ensuring successful implementation and alignment with business objectives.
- Design and implement efficient end-to-end supply chain concepts, including material, capacity, and financial flows across internal and external manufacturing networks.
- Drive capacity planning and loading strategies by balancing internal and external manufacturing resources, ensuring compliance with contractual commitments while optimizing cost, flexibility, capacity utilization, and service levels.
- Establish and lead cross-functional capacity and loading governance processes, including the development and maintenance of planning and loading tools.
- Analyze supply chain, inventory, demand, capacity, and supplier performance data, translating insights into actionable recommendations and management decisions.
- Develop and maintain KPIs, dashboards, and reporting tools to provide transparency, support decision-making, and monitor supply chain performance.
- Identify and drive process improvements across planning, logistics, production, and supply chain operations to enhance efficiency, visibility, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
- Support and improve system-driven processes through master data governance, data validation, process harmonization, and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Lead or contribute to cross-functional SCM initiatives and transformation projects, driving operational excellence and supply chain optimization.
- Proactively identify supply, capacity, and operational risks and develop mitigation plans to ensure business continuity and supply chain resilience.

Your Profile

- Master Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
- 5+ years of relevant professional experience in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Manufacturing, or a comparable industry environment.
- Experience working in project-driven and cross-functional environments; exposure to industrialization or manufacturing transfer projects is considered an advantage.
- Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and collaborate effectively in international organizations.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business decisions.
- High level of ownership, independence, and decision-making capability combined with a hands-on mentality.
- Strong process orientation with a continuous improvement mindset and the ability to manage complex activities in dynamic environments.
- Proficiency in SAP and Microsoft Office applications; experience with data analytics and reporting tools such as Power BI is an advantage.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to build trust-based relationships across all organizational levels.
- Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

Core Competencies

- Supply Chain & Capacity Management
- Project & Stakeholder Management
- Strategic Thinking & Business Acumen
- Data Analytics & Performance Reporting
- Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement
- Problem Solving & Decision Making
- Cross-Functional Collaboration
- Communication & Influencing Skills
- Agile Mindset & Change Management
- Attention to Detail & Execution Excellence

Imagine a future where you play a key role in ensuring electrical safety across our offshore substations and wind turbines while helping us push the boundaries of safe, efficient, and reliable offshore operations.

Join us in this role where you’ll take independent ownership of electrical safety within your area of responsibility, overseeing electrical installations on wind turbines in our German wind farms. You’ll combine your deep technical expertise with on-site presence—both at your permanent base in Norddeich and offshore—in order to guide colleagues, strengthen procedures, and ensure safe systems of work.

Welcome to HV and Transmission GER

You’ll be part of HV and Transmission GER, where you and your colleagues will ensure electrical safety governance and operational support across high-voltage infrastructure in our German offshore wind farms. Your team is dedicated to managing safety-critical systems, uplifting operational standards, and sharing expertise across the organisation.

As a team, we collaborate closely, support one another’s development, and bring a proactive, solution-oriented mindset to every challenge.

You’ll play an important role in:

- preparing and reviewing risk assessments for offshore electrical work
- supporting the selection, training, and supervision of Authorised Persons, electricians, and electrically instructed persons offshore
- contributing to the qualification and supervision of contractors in the offshore electrical environment
- developing, implementing, and improving maintenance plans for offshore electrical installations
- coordinating multiple employers involved in offshore electrical activities
- planning, organising, delivering, and documenting electrical safety training
- implementing, strengthening, and regularly reviewing the Wind Turbine Safety Rules (WTSR) and Orsted Electrical Safety Rules (OESR)
- assuming designated roles within the Safe Systems of Work, such as Authorising Engineer, Authorising Officer, or Training Mentor
- auditing work processes before offshore deployment.

To succeed in the role, you:

- have completed a degree within electrical engineering, or equivalent
- bring strong expertise within electrical safety, including standards, laws, and regulations
- demonstrate technical leadership competence
- offer switching experience in high-voltage environments above 20 kV
- communicate confidently in both English and German at B2 level or higher
- are comfortable using IT systems, including Microsoft Office, SAP, and AI tools
- ideally have a qualification for live working, experience with wind turbines, or prior responsibility as an electrician
- meet the minimum competency requirements within your onboarding timeframe, supported by our learning and development processes.

**Country-specific requirements: **fulfil the requirements of a responsible electrician (vEFK) according to VDE 1000-10.

Please note that in this role you will be mainly working in our office in Norddeich from Monday to Friday. An important part of the role will be an inspection of plants and the professional guidance of the electricians. This requires partial work offshore (20-40%) in a 7- or 14-day shift pattern.

Your missionWe are seeking a motivated Junior Fermentation Scientist to join our biotechnology team and support the development and optimization of microbial fermentation processes. This is a hands-on laboratory role with a strong focus on planning and executing fermentation experiments, from shake-flask cultivation to bench-scale fermentations.

You will work independently at the clean bench, prepare andoperate fermentation experiments, and monitor relevant process parameters and performance
indicators. Your responsibilities will also include analyzing key process and product KPIs using bioanalytical methods such as SDS-based analysis, enzymatic assays, and HPLC, as well as evaluating, documenting, and reporting experimental results.

The role offers a high degree of autonomy in organizing your day-to-day laboratory work, with responsibility for ensuring that experiments are thoroughly planned, executed, analyzed, and documented. You will contribute directly to improving our microbial fermentation workflows and advancing robust and scalable bioprocesses.
• Plan, prepare, and perform microbial cultivation and fermentation experiments, ranging from shake-flask cultures to bench-scale fermentations of up to 5 L
• Carry out laboratory work under aseptic conditions, including work at the clean bench and the preparation of culture media, buffers, solutions, and reagents
• Set up, operate, monitor, and maintain bench-top fermentation systems and associated laboratory equipment
• Monitor fermentation performance and evaluate relevant process and product KPIs throughout experimental campaigns
• Perform bioanalytical characterization of fermentation samples using methods such as SDS-based analysis, enzymatic assays, HPLC, and other relevant analytical techniques
• Evaluate experimental data, identify trends and deviations, and summarize results in a clear and structured manner
• Document experiments thoroughly and learn how to prepare concise reports of experimental results and conclusions
• Organize and prioritize your laboratory activities independently, ensuring that experiments are properly planned, executed, analyzed, and documented within agreed timelines
• Contribute to the maintenance and organization of microbial strains, cell banks, laboratory materials, and equipment
• Collaborate closely with colleagues across different disciplines and contribute to the continuous improvement of our fermentation processes and laboratory workflows

Your profile
• A degree or vocational qualification in biotechnology, microbiology, bioprocess engineering, biological laboratory technology (e.g. BTA), or a related field
• Practical experience working under aseptic conditions and confidence in standard microbiological and biotechnology laboratory techniques
• Hands-on experience with microbial cultivation; experience with shake-flask cultures and/or bench-scale fermenters is highly desirable
• Familiarity with the preparation of culture media, buffers, solutions, and reagents, as well as accurate sample handling and laboratory documentation
• Experience with, or a strong interest in learning, analytical methods for evaluating fermentation samples, such as SDS-based analysis, enzymatic assays, and HPLC
• A structured and reliable approach to experimental work, with the ability to independently organize laboratory activities and follow experiments through from preparation to data analysis and reporting
• A practical, hands-on mindset combined with curiosity, attention to detail, and a willingness to troubleshoot and learn new techniques
• A collaborative and team-oriented approach, while being comfortable taking ownership of assigned experiments and project tasks
• Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken; German is a plus

Our Benefits:
• Work for one of the global innovation leaders in the food industry.
• Dynamic and diverse mission-driven team from more than 25 different countries.
• A fast growing company with exceptional opportunities for personal development.
• Flat hierarchies and short decision paths.
• Flexible working hours with entitled Home Office days in an innovative and agile working environment.
• Gym Membership, language classes or an attractive alternative from our benefit program.
• Great team events such as “Lunch & Learn”, “Demo Day”, cultural celebrations and food tastings.
• Drinks, cereal bar and fresh fruit at the office, our home products tasting session for new employees.
• Lastly, join us in the journey as we change the food system as we know it!

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Ready to disrupt the food system with us?

Your visionUse your passion for a great user experience and your technical skills to help patients getting the right treatment without jumping through hoops such as the opening hours of pharmacies and doctor's offices.
You and the team build a platform for patients, doctors and our patient care team allowing everybody to collaborate across the full patient care cycle. The diverse user groups and their backgrounds demand simple, intuitive and high quality interfaces that you conceptualize and build in close collaboration with the team. Come join us and let us shape an emerging market.
Your mission We are looking for someone who:
• Understands and can anticipate the complexities of distributed asynchronous systems.
• Would not need instruction on how to set up or work with modern tech. This means everything from testing, localization, tooling, CI pipelines and so on. These are just “the way you work”
• Thrives in an environment of freedom to take ownership and make the choices required to deliver the highest value at the lowest cost and risk to our users.
• Values an iterative approach to solving a problem, validating the value and moving forwards.
• Is an engineer not bound by labels. We are looking for people with a good foundation of programming practices that can work on front end, dev ops, back end or native app problems to name a few examples. They would not be expected to be a “guru” at something right off the bat, but they would be expected to not fear diving into something new. Our Tech Stack is based on TypeScript, ReactJS, nodeJS, PHP, AWS and Flutte but this position will mostly working with React JS and node JS.
• Is a critical thinker who will design solutions that represent the business domain.
• Is stakeholder centric when trying to solve problems for them. This would mean wanting to truly understand the business domain and get as much information as possible from stakeholders before implementation of a solution.
• Is an exceptional communicator. They will need to have a fluent grasp of English and German would be a plus. This is integral to stakeholder centricity as communication is going to lead to the right solutions.
• Ideally would have a good history of working directly with departments like data analytics so when building software they have them in mind as part of the solution.

The position is initially limited to 18 months. This is in accordance with our internal governance and planning principles, under which we initially structure employment relationships for a defined period. Provided performance is satisfactory, there is generally the prospect of a long-term continuation of the employment relationship. A possible extension will be discussed well in advance of the fixed-term contract’s expiration.

Your profile What we can offer you:
• Flat structures, you will not have the feeling that you have a ‘Boss’
• Transparency is a first class citizen in the company
• Freedom from a JIRA todo list with no deviation. We want to hire people who tell us how to make the right choices and do the right things. We just want to present the problems that need solving.
• We are going to move and scale fast. There is plenty of room for career progression and we intend to hire the best talent we can get. This means you will learn a ton from very talented people.
• Trust, we are looking for people we do not need to manage.
• We don’t measure effort in “time” and we also don’t try to just translate story points to time either.
• We don’t believe in tech debt / bug sprints. Tech debt will always continue to happen, we simply acknowledge pain points and fix them as we go.

No tech is final. We want to use the tech that makes sense for the problem. That could mean a mongodb for one service and dynamo for another. We want you to be able to make that call.

The role leads manufacturing IT, factory digitalization, infrastructure, workplace services, and end-user support, ensuring reliable, secure, and efficient IT services for a 24/7 semiconductor manufacturing environment.

This is your new job

Factory IT Leadership

Manufacturing Systems & Factory Digitalization

- Lead lifecycle management, upgrades, and modernization of manufacturing systems.
- Drive factory automation, equipment integration, robotics, and smart manufacturing initiatives.

The (Sr.) Quality Assurance Engineer is responsible for applying quality tools, methods, and judgement to support manufacturing operations and ensure product and process compliance.

This is your new role

About the role

As Senior Characterization Engineer (m/f/d), you will join our talented and ambitious R&D team, directly contributing to our ability to successfully produce Gallium Nitride (GaN) devices.

What you will do

- Lead electrical verification strategy, encompassing front-end, back-end and lab testing

- Masters or Ph.D. degree in Electrical Engineering or Solid-State Physics

- Team player with strong problem-solving skills and a continuous improvement mindset
- Good communication skills in English (both spoken and written), German a plus

About the role

The Master Data / PLM Specialist is responsible for maintaining accurate product master data, Bills of Material (BOMs), and SAP production data throughout the product lifecycle. This role supports product releases, engineering changes, and new product introductions while ensuring data quality, governance compliance, and effective cross-functional collaboration across Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Quality teams.

Please note that this is a 12 month temporary assignment.

This is your new role:

- Product Data & BOM Maintenance: Create, update, and maintain product data and Bills of Material (BOMs), ensuring accuracy, consistency, and correct versioning throughout the product lifecycle.
- Change & Release Support: Support New Product Introductions (NPI) and updates by coordinating release readiness, verifying completeness, performing impact analysis, and assisting with approvals and release activities in PLM or related systems.
- SAP Production Material Master: Create and maintain SAP Production Material Masters and Production Versions to support production planning and execution.
- Data Quality & Governance: Apply data standards, naming conventions, and governance rules to maintain high data quality and prevent issues that could impact internal processes or customer-facing systems.
- Cross-functional Coordination: Collaborate closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, and other teams to ensure timely data updates, smooth approvals, and clear communication across stakeholders.
- Process Improvement & System Adoption: Support continuous improvement initiatives by documenting and optimizing workflows, promoting best practices, delivering training, and driving adoption of PLM systems across teams.

This is you:

- Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, IT or a related field or similar education with multiple years experience on a related field.
- Minimum 2 years of experience in data management, product administration, engineering support, or operational coordination, depending on educational credentials.
- Experience with PLM, ERP, or supply chain systems (Enovia, SAP, o9, or similar) is an advantage.
- Basic understanding of master data management, data accuracy, and structured processes.
- Hands-on working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and basic data analysis.
- Strong attention to detail and a structured, organized way of working.
- Good verbal and written communication skills in English (German will be an advantage)
- Collaborative mindset, with experience working in cross-functional teams.
- Proactive, supportive attitude with motivation to learn and grow in the role
